contexts.text: It is this (influx of innocence) which makes the love called storge.
Each has as many infants as she desires from spiritual storge. CL 410.
The lower minds of the consorts are drawn together by the love called storge.
The Angels love their spiritual offspring from a spiritual storge.
That conjugial love and the love of infants, which is called storge, have been conjoined...
This is the innocence of infancy which is the cause of the love which is called storge.

It is known that the love of infants, or storge, recedes from parents according to the recession of innocence from them... From this it may also be evident that innocence inflowing on both sides produces the love called storge.
The love called storge is then transferred from the wife into the husband...
No storge, and the consequent rejection of the infants (a really weighty cause of concubinage).
Compared to the consolations of mothers after parturition, when their love, called storge, manifests its delights.

The love of father and mother [is] from a love implanted in everyone, which is called storge... But love towards children... does not produce love towards the neighbour; for the love called storge exists with the evil equally as with the good; and sometimes it is stronger with the evil: it also exists with beasts and birds... with bears, tigers, and serpents, equally as with sheep and goats; and with owls equally as with doves.
But with those not in charity there is no conjunction of charity with the love called storge...
The beginning of true conjugial love is from the Inmost Heaven... Thence also comes storge; for the celestial of the Inmost Heaven thus love infants much more than their parents, or mothers.

Unless the Lord loved everyone, as a Father His children; and the Inmost Heaven [did so] from the Lord, as a mother her infants, storge would never come into existence. It cannot be impressed from self. That there is a greater storge towards the grandchildren... comes from the same source.

On the love of infants, or storge. - The reason the love of infants, and storge, is so universal in every living thing, is that such a sphere from the Lord through the Inmost Heaven encompasses where there are infancies, and affects especially the infants, and also the parents, especially the mothers... That the infants are especially affected, may be evident from their innocence in face, speech, gestures, which therefore affect the older people, in addition to the universal sphere... Hence the union of parents and their infants; and therefore; Iso it is diminished when the infants grow up...
Just as the affection towards children, or storge, is a common influx from the Lord.
The influx into the souls of brutes is also from Heaven and therefore they too are affected with conjugial love, and with storge.
When the love in parents towards children, or storge, was excited, they loved him tenderly.
(The influx of conjugial love and storge with the degenerated descendants of the Most Ancient Church.) Explained.
The womb is the inmost of the genital members; and from it is derived the maternal love which is called storge.
